test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following became the first Indian male shuttler to win silver in the men's singles event at the BWF World Championships on December 19, 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kidambi Srikanth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The BWF World Championships**, formerly **known **as **IBF World Championships**, and **also known **as the **World Badminton Championships**, is **a badminton tournament **sanctioned by **Badminton World Federation**.
 
• **Srikanth Kidambi **is an **Indian badminton player **who trains at the **Gopichand Badminton Academy**, **Hyderabad**.
 
• He was **ranked **the world **number 1 **in the **BWF rankings in April 2018**.
 
• **Kidambi was **awarded the **Padma Shri**, **India's fourth highest civilian award**, in **2018**. and the **Arjuna award in 2015**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prannoy Haseena Sunil Kumar**, also known as **H. S. Prannoy**, is an **Indian badminton player **who currently trains at the **Gopichand Badminton Academy in Hyderabad**.
 
• **Bhamidipati Sai Praneeth **is an **Indian badminton player**. He became the **first Indian male shuttler **in **36 years **to **win a bronze medal **in the **BWF World Championships in 2019 **after **Prakash Padukone in 1983**.
 
• **Lakshya Sen **is an **Indian badminton player**. **Sen **is a **former world junior no. 1**. He has **won gold medals **at the **2018 Asian Junior Championships **in the **boys' singles **and at the **Summer Youth Olympics in **the mixed **team event**.
